paite: Huchiin Elipha Teman miin a dawng a, hichiin a chi a;
english: Then Eliphaz the Temanite answered,

paite: Mihing Pathian adingin a phatuam thei diam? Kuapeuh a pil amah mah adingin a phatuam ngeia.
english: “Can a man be profitable to God? Surely he who is wise is profitable to himself.

paite: Na diktat, Thilbangkimhihthei adinga kipahna ahi himhim hia? ahihkeileh na lampite na hoihkim sak, amah dia punna hia?
english: Is it any pleasure to the Almighty, that you are righteous? Or does it benefit him, that you make your ways perfect?

paite: Nang a honsalha, vaihawmnaa nang toh a lut, amah na kihtak jiak hia?
english: Is it for your piety that he reproves you, that he enters with you into judgment?

paite: Na gitlouhna a lian kei maw? Na thulimlouhna ah leng tawpna a om sam kei hi.
english: Isn’t your wickedness great? Neither is there any end to your iniquities.

paite: Bangmahlou dingin na unau thuchiamte na lata ngala, huan vuaktangte a puansilh uh na suahsaka.
english: For you have taken pledges from your brother for nothing, and stripped the naked of their clothing.

paite: Gim adin dawn dingin tui na pe kei a, huan gilkial adin tanghou na it hi.
english: You haven’t given water to the weary to drink, and you have withheld bread from the hungry.

paite: Himahleh mi hat in gam a neia; mi deihthoh a sungah a teng hi.
english: But as for the mighty man, he had the earth. The honorable man, he lived in it.

paite: Khutvuakin meithaite na sawl manga, huan pabeite khutte hihtanin a om hi.
english: You have sent widows away empty, and the arms of the fatherless have been broken.

paite: Huaijiakin thangte na kim ah a om ua, huan lau guihnain nang honhihbuai hi.
english: Therefore snares are around you. Sudden fear troubles you,

paite: Ahihkeileh khomial, na muh theihlouh, leh tui tampiin nang a honkhuh hi.
english: or darkness, so that you can not see, and floods of waters cover you.

paite: Van sangah Pathian a om ka hia? huan aksite sandan en in, sang hina tel uh e;
english: “Isn’t God in the heights of heaven? See the height of the stars, how high they are!

paite: Huan nang, Pathianin bang a theia? khomial bikbek lakah vai a hawm thei dia hia?
english: You say, ‘What does God know? Can he judge through the thick darkness?

paite: Amaha dingin meipi sahte, a muhlouhna din, khuhna ahi a; huan van kum sungah a vak ahi, na chi.
english: Thick clouds are a covering to him, so that he doesn’t see. He walks on the vault of the sky.’

paite: Mi giloute totsa lampi lui na kem ding hia?
english: Will you keep the old way, which wicked men have trodden,

paite: A hun ma ua lak manga oma, a kingakna ua tuiluang banga butkhiak a omte:
english: who were snatched away before their time, whose foundation was poured out as a stream,

paite: Pathian kianga, Hon pai mangsanin; huan eia dingin Thilbangkimhihtheiin bang a hih theia? chite.
english: who said to God, ‘Depart from us;’ and, ‘What can the Almighty do for us?’

paite: Himahleh a inte uh thil hoihin a dimsak ua: himahleh migiloute thugen kei akipan a gamla hi.
english: Yet he filled their houses with good things, but the counsel of the wicked is far from me.

paite: Mi diktatten a mu ua, a kipak ua; huan mihoihten amau a nuihsan ua,
english: The righteous see it, and are glad. The innocent ridicule them,

paite: Chihtaktakin ei dou dinga thoute sat khiakin a om ua, huan amaute laka omlai meiin a hulgaita, chiin.
english: saying, ‘Surely those who rose up against us are cut off. The fire has consumed their remnant.’

paite: Tuin amah kimeltheihpih inla, muang takin omin: Huaiah hoih na kiangah a hongpai ding hi.
english: “Acquaint yourself with him, now, and be at peace. Thereby good shall come to you.

paite: A kam akipanin dan tuh sangin, ka honngen hi, huan na lungtang ah a thute khol khawmin.
english: Please receive instruction from his mouth, and lay up his words in your heart.

paite: Thilbangkimhihthei kianga na kik nawn leh, lam kipin na om ding hi; na puaninte akipana gamla pia diktatlouhna na koih mang leh.
english: If you return to the Almighty, you shall be built up, if you put away unrighteousness far from your tents.

paite: Huan na gou leivui ah koih inla, huan luite suangte lakah Ophir dang kaeng;
english: Lay your treasure in the dust, the gold of Ophir among the stones of the brooks.

paite: Huchiin Thilbangkimhihthei na gou ahi dia, nanga dingin manpha dangka.
english: The Almighty will be your treasure, and precious silver to you.

paite: Huchiin Thilbangkimhihthei ah na kipakin, Pathian kiangah na dak tou ding a hih jiakin.
english: For then you will delight yourself in the Almighty, and shall lift up your face to God.

paite: Amah kiangah na thumna na gen dia, aman a honza ding.
english: You shall make your prayer to him, and he will hear you. You shall pay your vows.

paite: Thil khat tungah thupukna bawlin thu na pe dia, huan nanga dia hihkipin a om ding hi; huan na lampite ah khovak a tang ding.
english: You shall also decree a thing, and it shall be established to you. Light shall shine on your ways.

paite: A honsawnpuk chiang un, Thoh touhna a om, na chi ding; huan mi niamkhiak aman a hondam ding hi.Amah a hoihlou nasan a suaktasak dinga: ahi, na khutte sianna jiakin amah suangtaksakin a om ding.
english: When they cast down, you shall say, ‘be lifted up.’ He will save the humble person.

paite: Amah a hoihlou nasan a suaktasak dinga: ahi, na khutte sianna jiakin amah suangtaksakin a om ding.
english: He will even deliver him who is not innocent. Yes, he shall be delivered through the cleanness of your hands.”
